name: set_confidence
description: Record how sure the learner is of their committed answer, before check_answer. 1 guess, 2 unsure, 3 fairly sure, 4 certain. Only allowed before the check.

attempt_id.description: The attempt_id returned by get_next_question for the current question.

level.description: The learner's confidence: 1 guess, 2 unsure, 3 fairly sure, 4 certain.
